limits: Only Python streams of completed-project GC/resources/control logs were read; no JVM, MAT, heap decoder or profile input was launched.
Per-run windows are exact START-to-END marker windows and include joined/static/cleanup work. Durations are not exact subphase windows.
joinedSealReleaseSeconds aggregates pre-bind capture/release plus post-bind close; it is not one contiguous interval. Binding log appears after close.
After-young-GC occupancy can include unreachable old objects; it is not a retained-heap census. Full-GC occupancy is a stronger low-water sample but has no owner attribution.
Cumulative pause-reclaimed bytes quantify churn through observed collections, not exact allocations or retained bytes; concurrent reclamation is not included.
Pause wall time is not native GC CPU. No GC/JIT/native CPU percentage is inferred.
RSS includes resident Java heap plus native/code/metadata/profiling/shared pages. RSS minus Xmx is not an exact native-owner measurement.
Without a fresh heap there is no actual-null-field, dominator, class-layout or measured release-byte census. Successful lifecycle logs are not such a census.
